lines.text: The pressure reaches you. The floor is still beneath your feet. There is nowhere left between you and it.
It has reached you. You have not reached for it. Those are different things.
I can let it carry me back. Or I can put my hand out and fight.
You keep your hand against your own chest. The pressure takes your weight.

I already broke free of it here. This will not be another fight. If I touch it again, it will take one available recording. I will have to find that recording here or in the next Source to hear it again. If none remain, it has nothing to take. I can still lower my hand.
Its fingers close. The tape does not move.
